title: London Underground poster
slide_intent: Connect a message to its surroundings because a situational reference can make a brief encounter feel relevant.
strategic_value: The Jubilee line wordplay and expressive Duo can bring Duolingo’s personality into a commuter’s immediate context.
demonstration: A photographed station poster uses a purple headline area reading “Jubilee line in a jumble? Learn Japanese” above a large green Duo face and white signature.
practical_value: Evaluate how a location-specific line and oversized mascot read in a real transit setting.

content_islands.name: Poster creative
content_islands.spec: Stack the place-specific headline, large Duo face and signature with app badges.

content_islands.name: Station context
content_islands.spec: Retain the tiled wall and dark frame around the poster to show viewing context.

reference_purposes.Application: The source shows the campaign installed in a London Underground poster frame and credits And Rising.
reference_purposes.Expression: Duo’s narrowed eyes and the alliterative headline give the placement a distinct tone.
